lastCompletedStory.title: Pagina HTML sem estilo que repolla /api/snapshot a cada 2000ms

nextStoryContext: GET / now serves inline, deliberately unstyled HTML from the existing Bun.serve process. Its browser script immediately fetches the relative /api/snapshot path, repeats at DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (2000 ms), and records distinct idle-payload versus active-cycle-payload data markers before rendering the JSON as text. No DOM test dependency, asset import, bundler, CSS, or second listener was added.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current Bun docs confirm routes may return Response objects from one Bun.serve instance; HTML imports invoke bundling, so the inline Response approach preserves the no-build Part A contract.
